cards.name: Glamour Self
cards.text: The caster gets two images. Each tackle or hit on them rolls a die first: on 1-4 it goes for an image and misses; on 5-6 it finds the real one and the images vanish.

cards.name: Air Long Pass
cards.text: Pass, skipping one row forward.

cards.name: Glamour Ball
cards.text: Pass. They think it went to the other lane: their player there is revealed, and nobody can intercept. Your receiver stays face down.
